capabilities.description: The rink can schedule public skating sessions, check them against the rules, and work out how many places are left once club bookings take up half or all of the ice.
capabilities.name: Public skating session scheduling and capacity management

capabilities.description: Customers can buy session tickets at the right price without the session being oversold. Payment goes through the payment provider. Bookings are settled when the payment result arrives, and unpaid bookings are released once their payment window runs out.
capabilities.name: Ticket sales with online payment

capabilities.description: The rink keeps track of its hire skates and how many of them are held by bookings, so customers can hire skates along with their tickets.
capabilities.name: Skate hire stock management

capabilities.description: Members get free sessions as part of their membership.
capabilities.name: Membership free-session entitlement

capabilities.description: Clubs can book all or half of the rink, with conflicting bookings detected. Each club has an hourly rate, and clubs are invoiced every month for the hours they booked, with half-rink hours charged at half the rate.
capabilities.name: Club rink hire and monthly invoicing

capabilities.description: The rink checks ice temperature readings from its sensor. If the ice stays too warm, the next session is put on hold and its booking holders are notified. A manager can then put the session back on sale, or cancel it and refund every ticket.
capabilities.name: Ice condition monitoring and session safety holds

capabilities.description: The manager gets a weekly report showing sales, attendance and refunds for each session, which sessions were held or cancelled because of the ice, and totals for the week.
capabilities.name: Weekly management reporting
